blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate approved on third reading on Monday a bill expanding the national nutrition programs under Republic Act No. 11037, or the Masustansyang Pagkain Para Sa Batang Pilipino Act. Senate Bill No. 2272, or the Expanded National Nutrition Program, sponsored by Sen. Bam Aquino, is among the Legislative-Executive Development Advisory Council (Ledac)
